title: Toast
description: A notification toast component with success, warning, error, and info types, progress bar, and configurable position.

content.description: React.ReactNode — Custom content that replaces message and description.

showProgress.description: Whether to show a progress bar countdown.

progressColor.description: Custom color for the progress bar.

icon.description: React.ReactNode — Custom icon replacing the default type icon.

showCloseButton.description: Whether to show a close/dismiss button.

onDismiss.description: () => void — Fires when the toast is dismissed.

role.description: ARIA role for the toast element.

style.description: Inline styles applied to the toast element.

pauseOnHover.description: Whether to pause the auto-dismiss timer on hover.

closeAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the close button.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.

onRemove.description: (id: string) => void — Internal callback to remove the toast from the provider.

maxToasts.description: How many toasts may be visible at once. Older ones leave as new ones arrive.

containerClassName.description: Additional classes for the toast container.

defaultDuration.description: How long a toast stays up, in milliseconds, when it does not set its own.

animationDuration.description: Enter and exit transition duration in milliseconds.

gap.description: Space between stacked toasts, in pixels.

zIndex.description: Stacking order for the toast container.

closeOnEscape.description: Dismisses the newest toast when Escape is pressed, unless something above it — an open dialog, drawer or menu — has already handled the key. On by default.

containerAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for the toast region.

classes.description: Class overrides for this component's slots.

unstyled.description: Drops the decorative default classes and keeps the structural ones, along with focus, keyboard and ARIA wiring.
